critic:
Hall geometry is fatal: an 11 m² 'spine along the length' of the 15.4 m internal bar is ~0.71 m clear width, narrower than the seven door leaves opening off it, with facing bedroom/bathroom doors colliding. A usable 1.2 m spine needs ~18.5 m², which the 105 m² programme plus internal walls cannot absorb inside 121.7 m² internal.

Self-contradictory section: rooms cannot be 'full-depth bays' (7.9 m) and flank a longitudinal hall. Taken literally, the 10 m² office at the gable is 1.27 m wide and the 8 m² bathroom 1.0 m — unfurnishable. Under the double-loaded reading rooms are ~3.5 m deep (workable), but then the 'full-width exterior bay' justification for the windowless bathroom is false and the living room is a 7.5 x 3.6 m corridor-room.

Orientation wastes the site: all zoning is east-west (loud west / quiet east), so nothing assigns living/kitchen and children's rooms to the deep south garden face; roughly half the habitable rooms may end up single-aspect north, negating the shallow-bar parti.
